summary: the last thirteen UNWIRED suites run in the full suite; three were broken and nobody could see it; test:crossing-build-list no longer steps over its own denominator floor; F7 checks the viewer resource destination and says NOT CHECKED when there is none

coordination.notes: Extends the owners rather than adding siblings. The viewer destination is read out of the config tools/build-release-config.mjs emits, and that file's existing viewer.rs contract check is invoked and its refusal reported, not re-implemented in bundle-test.mjs. The two suites that lacked a generated input build it the way tools/geometric-room-briefs-test.mjs already does for its own. No new tool file. package.json is untouched: every one of the thirteen scripts already existed, which was the whole complaint. portrait-art and room-scene-patterns read files rewrite/remove-2d proposes to delete (section 3 matrix, C7 undecided) - registering a passing test does not touch them, but that branch now owns two more suites and should, rather than have them stay unregistered.
